comparison.objective: Feed a lamp cord through a narrow center pipe and leave the specified free length.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable cable insertion with repeated hand-over-hand regrasping.
comparison.success_condition: Cord passes through with 60–100 mm exposed, released and still for one second.
comparison.reason: Cable feeding and length control do not exercise coupled screw/nut locking or post-lock cyclic retention.
